subject.title: Add an FxTwitter read transport for public lookups, threads, profiles, and search

question: Should Birdclaw own and support FxTwitter as an opt-in core live-read transport, and if so which public capabilities belong in its first supported contract?
rationale: The implementation is technically bounded, but adding a third-party provider creates lasting configuration, privacy, compatibility, and support obligations that source inspection cannot authorize.

options.title: Approve a narrow core MVP
options.body: Support explicit post, thread or conversation, profile, public-status, and search reads while rejecting authenticated and write capabilities before any request.

options.title: Keep existing transports only
options.body: Decline the additional provider and resolve live-transport guidance through https://github.com/steipete/birdclaw/issues/93 instead.

options.title: Define an external adapter API first
options.body: Establish a stable transport-extension contract before deciding whether FxTwitter should live outside the core repository.

recommendation.title: Approve a narrow core MVP
recommendation.body: Support explicit post, thread or conversation, profile, public-status, and search reads while rejecting authenticated and write capabilities before any request.

likelyOwner.reason: As repository owner and the person subscribed to this provider-direction discussion, steipete is the clearest authority for the core-support decision.
